data: Is the performance of the blue line higher than the performance of the orange line in the left subplot?

The left subplot shows the performance comparison with respect to the window size 'm'. The blue line represents the performance of the STS dataset, while the orange line represents the performance of the SICK-E dataset. The performance is measured as the Pearson Correlation Coefficients (×100). 

From the figure, we can observe that the blue line (STS) remains relatively flat across different window sizes, while the orange line (SICK-E) shows a slight upward trend. However, the blue line consistently stays below the orange line throughout the range of window sizes shown in the plot. Therefore, the performance of the blue line is not higher than the performance of the orange line in the left subplot.
